# Changes in version 0.1.0 (2026-10-14)

## `convert_rlum2xlum()`

- The `file` argument was renames to `out_file` for consistency with the
  other `convert_*2xlum()` functions (#1).

- Improved input object validation (#3).

- Objects with `.uid` slot set to `NA` and no `parentID` specified in
  the `info` slot field can now be converted correctly (#5).

- The attributes from the `xlum_prototype` file are read only once and
  then cached, rather than at each function call (#7).

## Other changes

- The documentation was revamped.
